p: Victoria Road is where Hartlepool's town centre does its business, with Middleton Grange right behind it and the war memorial out front, so this is very much a shopping-street adult gaming centre. Over 18s only, no exceptions.

If you've come into town for more than a few spins, Hartlepool's real draw is down by the water. The National Museum of the Royal Navy sits on the historic quay at the marina, home to HMS Trincomalee, an old wooden warship you can climb aboard. Navigation Point next door has places to eat with views over the boats. And for a bit of seaside, Seaton Carew's beach and front are a short drive or bus ride south of the centre.
